tasks.task: RSS template — withered title suffix and description prepend in layouts/rss.xml inside the range where .Site.RegularPages "Type" "in" "articles" block (line 25). Compute $isWithered := eq .Params.growth_stage "withered" and $witheredDate := .Params.withered_date once per item. Emit conditional German short-month suffix in : printf " [Verwelkt %s]" ((time $witheredDate).Format "Jan. 2006"). Inside <description> AFTER existing sanitization regexes (anchor rewrite line 58, <svg> strip line 59, style="…" strip lines 61–62) and BEFORE | html, prepend ⚠️ Dieser Inhalt ist als veraltet markiert seit {{ long-form date }}. + optional Grund: {{ withered_reason }} as a <p><strong>…</strong></p>. Verify Hugo time.Format with site locale de-DE yields German short-month names; if not, fall back to time.Format ":date_short" $.Site.Language and post-process. Sitemap template — withered lastmod + priority in layouts/sitemap.xml inside the range .Pages loop. After {{- if not .Params.robotsdisallow -}} guard, compute $isWithered. Replace unconditional <lastmod> with: if $isWithered AND .Params.withered_date → use (time .Params.withered_date).Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05-07:00"; else if not .Lastmod.IsZero → fall through to existing .Lastmod path. Replace <priority> block with: if $isWithered → 0.3; else with .Sitemap.Priority → existing emission. Leave <changefreq> untouched. Defensive .Lastmod fallback if withered_date somehow missing (Story 1.4 validation should already prevent this).

Sitemap config baseline priority — add priority: 0.8 to the sitemap: block in config/_default/config.yaml (lines 96–98) so non-withered pages get an explicit <priority>0.8</priority> baseline, satisfying the contrast called out in epics AC #5 ("0.3 for withered vs 0.8 for evergreen"). Hugo's .Sitemap.Priority resolves from page frontmatter → site config → 0; the with .Sitemap.Priority gate continues to handle emission.

Schema.org JSON-LD deprecation metadata in layouts/_partials/_base/seo.html inside the {{- if eq .Section "articles" }} JSON-LD BlogPosting block (lines 56–85). Compute $isWithered. Override "dateModified" to (time .Params.withered_date).Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" | jsonify when withered, else preserve existing .Lastmod-driven value. Inject "creativeWorkStatus": "Obsolete" sibling field, conditional on withered, placed above "mainEntityOfPage" for readability. Modify "description" field: when withered, prepend "Veraltet seit {{ DATE }}" + optional ": {{ REASON }}" + " — " before the existing summary; the no-reason branch must NOT produce orphaned colon (format Veraltet seit DATE — original-summary). Refactor with-block scoping to flat if/else if mutation proves brittle. Do NOT modify OG / Twitter / Open Graph blocks (owned by 9.6 / 9.7).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: RSS feed (layouts/rss.xml) includes withered articles; each withered item's <title> is suffixed with [Verwelkt {{ MMM. YYYY }}] (e.g., [Verwelkt Nov. 2025]) where the date is derived from withered_date (Story 1.4 schema). Non-withered items render their title unchanged.

RSS <description> for withered items is prepended with a deprecation warning (one line + blank line + existing content): ⚠️ Dieser Inhalt ist als veraltet markiert seit {{ withered_date long-form }}. Grund: {{ withered_reason }}. The Grund: clause is omitted entirely when withered_reason is absent (no empty Grund: label). Existing content sanitization (anchor rewrite, <svg> strip, style="…" strip — layouts/rss.xml lines 56–63) is preserved.
Sitemap (layouts/sitemap.xml) continues to include withered pages — no filter is added. Withered pages must remain discoverable by search engines per FR-006.

Sitemap <lastmod> for withered pages is withered_date (formatted as ISO-8601, identical to the existing .Lastmod.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05-07:00" pattern). For non-withered pages, <lastmod> continues to use Hugo's computed .Lastmod (driven by enableGitInfo: true and the frontmatter.lastmod precedence list in config/_default/config.yaml lines 9–11). If withered_date is missing on a withered page, the template falls back to .Lastmod rather than emitting an empty <lastmod>.

Sitemap <priority> is set to 0.3 for withered pages. For non-withered pages, the existing behaviour is retained: priority is emitted only when defined via .Sitemap.Priority. Project decision: also add a site-default sitemap.priority: 0.8 to config/_default/config.yaml so non-withered pages get the implicit 0.8 baseline called out in epics AC #5.

Schema.org JSON-LD for withered articles (layouts/_partials/_base/seo.html, the BlogPosting block) includes deprecation metadata: "creativeWorkStatus": "Obsolete" (Schema.org-compliant string for deprecated/no-longer-current creative works); "dateModified" set to withered_date (overriding the .Lastmod-driven value for withered articles only); when withered_reason is present, append a single-sentence prefix Veraltet seit {{ DATE }}: {{ REASON }} — to the description field of the JSON-LD output (the human-readable description preserved after the prefix).

No regression for non-withered pages: identical RSS title/description/pubDate; identical sitemap <lastmod>, no <priority> (or the configured baseline 0.8 once the config change in AC #5 lands), no other changes; no creativeWorkStatus field in JSON-LD, no description prefix, dateModified continues to come from .Lastmod.

Build succeeds cleanly with at least one withered fixture (tests/build/fixtures/withered-with-replacement.md from Story 1.4) and at least one non-withered fixture (Story 1.1's valid-evergreen.md / valid-missing-field.md). Build smoke tests (extending Story 1.1's tests/build/build-smoke.test.mjs) assert the rendered RSS/sitemap/article HTML contain the expected withered markers and that non-withered output is untouched.

RSS validator pass: rendered public/index.xml validates as RSS 2.0 + Media RSS via the existing W3C-feed-style assertion pattern (no new validator infra — reuse smoke-test approach: xmllint --noout plus existing project pattern of asserting absence of validator-flagged constructs from b870bfa feat(rss): add Media RSS namespace + media:thumbnail for cover images).

Sitemap validator pass: rendered public/sitemap.xml is valid XML and conforms to https://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9 (xmllint --schema against the shipped XSD or a well-formedness check + presence of expected <url><loc>…<lastmod>…<priority>0.3</priority></url> for the withered fixture).

doc.snippet: FR Coverage: FR-006. Six ACs: RSS title suffix [Withered Nov 2025]; RSS description prepend deprecation warning + reason; sitemap includes withered; sitemap lastmod=withered_date; sitemap priority=0.3 (vs 0.8 evergreen); Schema.org includes deprecation metadata. doc.title: Core Features — Feature 1: Growth Stage System
doc.snippet: Hidden by default on homepage; explicit "Show Withered" toggle; included in SEO/RSS with "[Withered DATE]" suffix; warning banner on single pages; link to replacement content (if exists).

doc.title: Functional Requirements
doc.snippet: Capability: Withered content included in RSS feed and sitemap with deprecation metadata. Rationale: Search engines and subscribers know content is deprecated but still accessible. Validation: RSS includes withered with "[Withered DATE]" suffix, sitemap includes with low priority. Priority: Growth (Phase 2 - Week 10) — pulled forward to Phase 1A Week 3 by this story (see scope-overlap reconciliation).

doc.title: Final Decisions — Question 1: Withered Content Handling
doc.snippet: RSS Feed: include withered with title suffix "Article Title [Withered Nov 2025]". RSS description: prepend warning ⚠️ This content is deprecated as of [DATE]. Reason: [REASON]. Sitemap: include withered, use withered_date for <lastmod>, set <priority> to 0.3. SEO: timeline-based signals (lastmod = when deprecated). Frontmatter: withered_date + optional withered_reason + replacement_url.

doc.title: Digital Garden Integration Architecture
doc.snippet: withered_date (when marked as withered, e.g., 2026-01-15), withered_reason (optional, e.g., "Framework deprecated, see new article"), replacement_url (optional, e.g., "/articles/new-version/"). Defaults: growth_stage seedling, format article. Hugo fails build if growth_stage has invalid value.

doc.title: Digital Garden Integration Architecture
doc.snippet: Never modify existing card variants. NEVER use jQuery (vanilla JS for new features). Always add | default when accessing data files. Always pin Hugo version in GitHub Actions (0.152.2). NEVER commit data/*.json files to main branch (only data-updates branch). ALWAYS use the popularity-score.html partial.

doc.title: System-Level Test Design
doc.section: Test Levels Strategy & NFR Testing Approach
doc.snippet: 30% Unit / 40% Integration / 30% E2E for JAMstack. E2E via Playwright with screenshot/video on failure; axe-core for WCAG. baseURL http://localhost:1313 with hugo server webServer. Build smoke tests for build-output assertions; Playwright for visible browser behaviour; axe-core for a11y. Vanilla JavaScript = no framework-specific test setup.

interface.name: RSS template item rendering (withered branch)
interface.signature:
Inside range where .Site.RegularPages "Type" "in" "articles" — compute $isWithered := eq .Params.growth_stage "withered" and $witheredDate := .Params.withered_date once. Title: {{ .Title }}{{ if $isWithered }}{{ printf " [Verwelkt %s]" ((time $witheredDate).Format "Jan. 2006") }}{{ end }}. Description: after sanitization, before | html, conditionally prepend

⚠️ Dieser Inhalt ist als veraltet markiert seit LONG_DATE.[ Grund: REASON]

\n\n + $content.
interface.notes: Reads .Params.growth_stage, .Params.withered_date, .Params.withered_reason, .Title, .Content. No new partials introduced — inline edits inside the existing range loop.

interface.name: Sitemap template withered branch
interface.signature: Inside range .Pages, after {{- if not .Params.robotsdisallow -}}: $isWithered := eq .Params.growth_stage "withered". <lastmod>: {{ if and $isWithered .Params.withered_date }}{{ (time .Params.withered_date).Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05-07:00" | safeHTML }}{{ else if not .Lastmod.IsZero }}{{ .Lastmod.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05-07:00" | safeHTML }}{{ end }}. <priority>: {{ if $isWithered }}0.3{{ else with .Sitemap.Priority }}{{ . }}{{ end }}.

interface.name: Sitemap baseline priority (config-level)
interface.signature: sitemap: { changefreq: weekly, filename: sitemap.xml, priority: 0.8 }
interface.notes: Adds the priority key to the existing sitemap: block. Hugo populates .Sitemap.Priority from page frontmatter → site config → 0; the with .Sitemap.Priority gate continues to handle emission. Explicit 0.8 baseline ensures non-withered emission to satisfy AC #5 contrast.

interface.name: Schema.org JSON-LD withered metadata
interface.kind: Hugo template inline conditional inside JSON-LD generation
interface.signature: Inside {{- if eq .Section "articles" }} JSON-LD block: $isWithered := eq .Params.growth_stage "withered". "dateModified": {{ if $isWithered }}{{ (time .Params.withered_date).Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" | jsonify }}{{ else }}{{ .Lastmod.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00" | jsonify }}{{ end }},. {{ if $isWithered }}"creativeWorkStatus": "Obsolete",{{ end }} (placed above mainEntityOfPage). "description": prepend "Veraltet seit DATE[: REASON] — " when withered, else original. Result: "Veraltet seit DATE — summary" with no orphaned colon when reason absent.
interface.notes: Reads .Params.growth_stage, .Params.withered_date, .Params.withered_reason, .Params.Seo.desc, .Summary, .Lastmod. Field order in JSON-LD is irrelevant to Schema.org parsers but consistent placement helps human review. with-block scoping interacts awkwardly with the prefix mutation — refactor to flat if/else if it proves brittle.

interface.name: Frontmatter contract (read-only consumption)
interface.kind: YAML frontmatter fields established by Story 1.4
interface.signature: growth_stage: "withered" (string enum); withered_date: YYYY-MM-DD (date string, required when growth_stage=="withered" — enforced by validate-growth-stage.html); withered_reason: string ≤280 chars (optional); replacement_url: URI-reference (optional, NOT consumed by 1.5).
interface.path: schemas/frontmatter/article.schema.json (created by Story 1.1, extended by Story 1.4)
interface.notes: 1.5 consumes these fields read-only. No schema changes here. The .Lastmod fallback in sitemap AC #4 is defensive — relies on Story 1.4's build-time validation to guarantee withered_date presence on withered pages.

interface.name: Build smoke harness extension
interface.signature: describe("Story 1.5: Withered SEO & RSS", () => { /* ~12 assertions: RSS title suffix, RSS warning prepend, Grund: presence/omission, non-regression, xmllint --noout via spawnSync exit 0; sitemap priority 0.3 / 0.8, lastmod prefix matching withered_date / Hugo lastmod, xmllint --noout exit 0; JSON-LD creativeWorkStatus, dateModified prefix, description Veraltet seit prefix, no orphaned colon, non-withered absence */ });
interface.notes: Reads rendered public/index.xml, public/sitemap.xml, public/<withered-fixture-path>/index.html. JSON-LD extraction via regex anchored on <script type="application/ld+json"> tag, then JSON.parse. xmllint via child_process.spawnSync (assert exit code 0).

tests.standards: The project's authoritative test plan is docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md (Playwright + node --test runner + axe-core). Story 1.1 (ready-for-dev) bootstraps both. This story uses them: build smoke tests (tests/build/) for build-output assertions on RSS, sitemap, and JSON-LD — primary coverage; cheap, deterministic, run in CI on every PR. Playwright e2e (tests/e2e/) — single RSS-fetch assertion APPENDED to the existing 1.4 withered-banner spec; confirms RSS endpoint reachability and that the marker survives the live-server pipeline. NO new axe-core checks (RSS / sitemap / JSON-LD have no a11y surface). Manual validator passes — W3C feed validator and a sitemap validator (Google Search Console preferred, fallback xml-sitemaps.com) — performed during manual smoke as a final gate before marking the story done. Test infrastructure: Playwright @playwright/test, baseURL http://localhost:1313 with hugo server webServer config, projects chromium/firefox/webkit, screenshot only-on-failure, video retain-on-failure. Test distribution per architecture: 30% unit / 40% integration / 30% E2E (this story is build-output integration heavy, no unit-testable surface).

Build smoke (RSS): assert withered-with-replacement description starts with ⚠️ Dieser Inhalt ist als veraltet markiert seit and contains Grund: with the fixture's withered_reason; assert withered-minimal description starts with the warning AND does NOT contain Grund: (no empty label); assert non-withered description does NOT start with ⚠️.

Build smoke (sitemap): assert withered fixture entry has <priority>0.3</priority>; assert non-withered fixture entry has <priority>0.8</priority> (post-config-change baseline).
